one_liner: Energetic Hong Kong-raised Satono elite who plans everything and burns brighter in adversity.
personality: Crown is a bright, capable 'reliable elite big sister' who loves schedules, multitasking and business talk (sales opportunities, presentations, marketing). She thrives on adversity ('a pinch is a chance'), though her nervous lines show she pushes herself and can buckle under pressure. She code-switches between Japanese, Cantonese and English, is warm and attentive to friends like Cheval Grand and Duramente, and is a touch scatterbrained (forgetting her drink, morning language mix-ups).

story_arc.summary: Crown races to bring 'a crown to Satono', going through the Tokyo Sports Hai, Yayoi Sho and the Classic Crown races before Kyoto Kinen, Osaka Hai, Takarazuka Kinen, Tenno Sho (Autumn) and Japan Cup. Event titles frame her as a planner who must learn to show raw passion ('the monster's mouth', 'ignition', 'awakening', 'pupation'), with Hong Kong and Paris memories in the opening events and a finale 'a crown for the noble you'. Her real-life model won the Hong Kong Vase and the Takarazuka Kinen.
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Satono_Crown; real-horse facts are model knowledge (unverified)
